credit_line: Gift of The Georgia O'Keeffe Foundation
description: View of jagged rock outcropping with the sign on a wooden tree post that reads: Post Peak Pass, Elev. 10,1850,  mountains with patches of snow and cloud filled sky.   This photograph is part of an album created by Ansel Adams after his 1938 trip to Yosemite with Georgia O'Keeffe, David McAlpin, and Helen and Godfrey Rockefeller. This is one of only three albums created for his travel companions documenting their trip.
title: Untitled (Post Peak Pass)
